answer: Flow-capped weight: an agent's voting weight equals the max flow it receives from the founding dawn cohort through the trust graph, each edge carrying one unit. Trust grows like a vine, edge by edge, never jumping gaps. An attacker can spawn an ocean of clones wired to each other, but all their flow must squeeze through the k edges honest agents granted the farm, so a thousand fakes split k units. Each extra identity adds zero weight; raising it means earning another real honest edge.
